verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for a search database, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of API keys, role-scoped credentials, or least-privilege tokens for agents. The only related items are community mentions of a paid security suite and 'fine-grained access control' as a proprietary add-on, which are adjacent and do not document scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
